title: Configure report access for a role — TVM/Cash reports
preface: This test is to confirm that an administrator can manage which TVM/Cash reports a role can access, including specific reports.
preconds: **GIVEN** an administrator is signed into CloudFare

steps.content: **WHEN** the administrator sets the TVM/Cash report access for a role, including specific report access
steps.expected: **THEN** the role can access only the permitted TVM/Cash reports

expected:
A role's TVM/Cash report access matches the administrator's configuration.

[Automatable: Yes · Cross-check: CloudFare]

title: Configure module and group access for a role — operator-scope claims
preface: This test is to confirm that an administrator can set a role's operator-scope claim (CF Full Operator vs CF-Operator-<Name>).
preconds: **GIVEN** an administrator is signed into CloudFare

steps.content: **WHEN** the administrator sets a role's operator-scope claim — CF Full Operator (AccessControlFullAccess, all operators in hierarchy) or CF-Operator-<Name> (AccessControl<name>, that operator only, no sub-operators)
steps.expected: **THEN** the role's visible operators match the configured scope

expected:
A role's operator-scope claim (Full Operator vs a named single operator) matches the administrator's configuration.

[Automatable: Yes · Cross-check: CloudFare]

title: Fares export — standard fares list is exported
preface: This test is to confirm the user can export the standard fares list from CloudFare.
preconds:
**GIVEN** the user is signed into CloudFare
**AND** routes with a shared Service Group have fares configured (e.g. routes sharing one service group)

steps.content: **WHEN** the user runs the fares export for the standard fares list (XLSX or CSV)
steps.expected:
**THEN** the fares file is produced
**AND** **UNCONFIRMED** — the export surface/parameters are not confirmed; confirm live

expected:
The standard fares list for the selected operator is exported (XLSX or CSV).
